_actorAliases_comment: Former screen name -> current one, for performers the roster credits under both. Used ONLY to decide whether two roster rows are the same person; each record still displays the name the wiki credited, since that is what rolled on screen. Note the roster cannot establish these on its own — it wikilinks 陳偉琪 and 陳思圻 to two different articles with no 前名 annotation — so an entry here needs an outside source. This one: 陳思圻 (Vicky Chan Sze Kei), 原名 陳偉琪. Her 雷珍妮 rows are independently one character anyway (both bios open Jenny；, both tag 二房派, both name 龍力士 as husband, and 雷恭's row says 雷珍妮之父, singular).
_characterMerges_comment: Recasts: one 角色 the roster lists once per performer who played them. Unlike actorAliases these are genuinely different people, so each fold is scoped to one 角色 name — 鄧美欣 also plays 高芬 and must not become 呂善婷 there. There is no single test. Five of these are a rowspan on the 角色 column, i.e. the wiki itself declaring one character across N performers; the other three are separate rows resting on adjacency plus cross-references elsewhere in the roster. Bio text is NOT the criterion: 市場部 gives every extra the bio 職員, while 頌姐's two bios disagree and are still one person. Complete as of this writing — these are 8 of the 15 名 the roster credits to more than one actor; the other 7 (Angela / Fred / Sam / Ivy / 小雲 / Emily / the 島大 Gina) are different people sharing a common given name and stay separate. A stale entry is reported by warnStaleFolds rather than failing silently.

_nicknames_comment: Commonly-used character nicknames for searching the 角色 filter. Keyed by canonical character name. Extend freely.
_plotlines_comment: Curated 故事線, appended to the wiki's 故事系列 index by build-data.mjs. The wiki models story lines as relationship pairs, so add one here only for an arc that belongs to a single character or a cast the pairs cannot express. `episodes` is numbers only — titles are read back out of the episode list. `characters` are canonical roster names; a line shows up on each of their character pages.

plotlines.name: 黑化Terry線
plotlines.summary: 龍力蓮以「垂蓮聽政」操控龍力王談生意，力王自恨蠢鈍而轉向中醫館求變聰明；針灸意外刺激了腦內水瘤，他智力暴增並性情大變：架空力蓮、逼使余愛詩與Peter歸順大房、將吳家聰降職，更為與二房爭繼承人之位而盤算政治婚姻。直至頭痛揭出水瘤危及性命，才被力蓮、家聰強行送院手術打回原形，其後逐一贖回黑化期間的所作所為。

_featured_comment: Curated entry points for the home page's 精選 row, in display order. `kind` picks which catalogue `ref` is resolved against — plotline/character by name, tag by label. build-data.mjs warns on anything that no longer resolves (a renamed plot line, a dropped tag) rather than shipping a dead card.
